faq.title: Your questions, answered
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started with Diya.
faq.contactText: Our team replies on WhatsApp or by email.

items.q: Does Diya work without an Internet connection?
items.a: Yes. Diya is 100% offline: everything is saved on your phone and stays available at any time, even with no network.
Your database is encrypted and protected by a biometric lock. Your data never leaves your device without your consent.

items.q: Can I manage several properties and units?
items.a: Yes, as many as you like: apartments, houses, hotels, furnished units, shops and offices.
Yes, for hotels and furnished units: by the hour, day or month, with automatic totals and a shareable receipt.

items.q: How do I back up my data?
items.a: Diya backs up automatically to your Google Drive, with no password. You can restore your data on a new device.

items.q: Which currency can I bill in?
items.a: In CFA francs by default, tailored to West Africa, with clear receipts that stay faithful when printed.
